dedupe_keys.name: off design modeling and performance assessment of a thermally integrated 6 kwe pumped thermal energy storage system using a reversible orc hp

description: Elise Neven and co-authors document an off-design model of a 6 kWe thermally integrated pumped thermal energy-storage system. The reversible Organic Rankine Cycle and heat-pump design reuses components and can receive low-temperature heat from district heating. Component models are assembled for both operating modes and used to calculate performance maps across district-heating, storage and ambient temperatures. The abstract explicitly places this modelling before the first experimental tests, so it does not establish experimental validation. Zenodo provides the conference paper freely under CC BY 4.0; code availability and separate code terms remain unknown. Coverage is a proposed test-bench system, without a stated location or simulated year. Related FlexGeo experiments describe later equipment measurements but are not assumed to validate this model. No article body or source code was read, and the performance maps were not independently checked.
